title: Exposing tcherber: VPN Access Brokerage, Custom Malware, & C2 Panel
content_md: Key Findings Howler Cell identified a database containing more than 500 FortiGate VPN credential entries , together with VPN connection records showing successful root-level network tunnels into multiple victim environments during May and June 2026. The recovered Go-based offensive toolkit supports FortiGate and SonicWall VPN access, internal network discovery, Active Directory enumeration, SMB reconnaissance, and credential validation, indicating a structured workflow for enterprise access operations. Continued infrastructure tracking uncovered a live, unauthenticated STANDALONE C2 Panel v3 at 158[.]94[.]209[.]138, containing 178 active bots, an integrated payload builder, FUD cryptor, and multiple delivery-chain variants. The panel contained fresh agent builds dated September 2026 , demonstrating that the infrastructure remained active at the time of analysis. Darkweb research identified posts on rehubcom[.]pro advertising VPN access, custom C2 and loader development, and crypting services. The posts shared a common Tox contact, providing an additional link between the operator’s underground activity and the recovered tooling.
